text:
maya: ACME pilot just passed legal. They want a private VPC deploy with HSM, launch window in ~6 weeks. Demands: 99p latency SLA (conversational), predictable cost. Need blockers + owners.
shiv: 6 weeks is tight. Is the SLA for pilot only or global?
maya: pilot only, 2 tenants, peak ~30rps, morning spikes. Latency > cost for them.
emily (Runtime): For tails we need pinned model + execution profile. q8 hits cost but long-context 99p may suffer without prewarm and per-tenant KV caching.
noah: Infra: private = subnet + NLB + reserved nodes. Recommend 2x GPU canary + 4x pilot. On-prem HSM integration lead ~3w unless we reuse staging.
tara (Security): HSM/KMS + ATO checklist are gating. Audit log retention must be configurable. I can fast-track high-risk items if infra provides stubs.
alex (SRE): 99p doable if we ensure warm pools, KV prefix caching, and a fallback plan to a smaller model for low-priority routes. Need explicit degradation doc for customer.
ops-oncall: Note burst prewarm will spike costs during business hours. Define capacity ramp window and alerts: gpu-queue > 60% escalate.
shiv: Engineering plan: 1) pick model & quant profile, 2) post-quant perf runbook, 3) runtime toggles for prewarm + KV caching, 4) canary plan. Est 2.5w of eng work if infra ready.
emily (Runtime): I'll produce a perf matrix (float16/q8/q4) with 95/99/99.9. Will include a perf harness snippet we can reuse.
noah: I'll check staging reuse by EOD tomorrow. If staging available infra time drops to ~4 days; otherwise procurement adds ~2w. Need TLS certs and private DNS entries.
tara (Security): If infra can provide HSM test keys today, I can do an initial review in 48h. I'll start an ATO checklist and mark top blockers.
alex (SRE): I'll draft the runbook including rollback criteria: auto rollback if 99p regresses >5% during canary.
maya: Proposed owners/dates: model pin + perf matrix -> emily (4bd); infra + certs -> noah (7bd); security + HSM stub -> tara (8bd); runtime prewarm + KV toggles -> shiv/emily (10bd); canary + runbook -> alex (12bd). Agreement?
shiv: OK if staging reusable. Need synthetic workload generator for 99p tests; will reuse runtime harness.
emily (Runtime): Recommend per-tenant cache TTL to reduce tail variance; will attach matrix EOD+4.
ops-oncall: Decide whether to permit cold starts for low-priority routes; cold starts hurt 99p. Suggest marking low-priority as async batch.
shiv: We'll add route flag `priority=high|low` and route low to async batch job.
maya: ACME wants an explicit degradation behavior doc and cost expectations. I'll draft customer-facing doc and circulate. Need go/no-go one week before launch.
noah: INFRA ticket created -> INFRA-1247. I'll update with staging availability and procurement path.
tara (Security): Uploading checklist and preliminary signoff status to the thread shortly.
shiv: Opening a small PR for prewarm toggles and linking it here.
emily (Runtime): Perf matrix ETA EOD+4.
alex (SRE): Runbook + alert thresholds will be drafted this week.
deploy-bot: infra-bot: INFRA-1247 created and assigned to noah.
maya: Thanks all 44d. Please flag blockers here; want final recommendation 7 days before launch.
